bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 站上全部均线，仍低于 $271.5–275.3

read.en: Amazon rose 1.5% on Nov 10 to $270.87, trading $266.14–272.88. It is above the 5-day ($264.7), 10-day ($255.8), 30-day ($255.2), 100-day ($253.1) and 200-day ($244.2); all five averages are rising. MACD has been above its signal since Nov 4, above zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 4 ($236.08), and RSI is 62.
read.zh: 亚马逊 11月10日上涨 1.5%，收于 $270.87，盘中区间 $266.14–272.88。股价位于 5 日（$264.7）、10 日（$255.8）、30 日（$255.2）、100 日（$253.1）和 200 日（$244.2）均线上方；五条均线均在上行。MACD 自 11月4日起位于信号线上方，在零轴上方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月4日起看多（$236.08），RSI 为 62。

read.en: No level changed: the close held above the $263.9–265.3 support (Nov 4 low, Oct 20 high) and stayed under the $271.5–275.3 highs of Nov 4, 5 and 9. Resistance is $271.5–275.3, then $278.6 (May 5 high) and $287.2 (52-week high). Support is $263.9–266.1 (5-day $264.7, Nov 10 low), then $258.5–259.3 and $253.1–255.8 (10, 30 and 100-day). A close above $275.3 would target $278.6; below $263.9, $258.5.
